facts.fact: Honmachi lies one street away from the canal waterfront and developed earlier as the road connectingKurashiki andHayashima, with cabinetmakers and coopers.
facts.excerpt: 古くは倉敷と早島を結ぶ街道で、倉敷川沿いより先に町となり箪笥屋、桶屋など職人達が軒を連ねる場所でした。

facts.fact: Its present streets include latticed lodging, a sake brewery, the Achi approach, and reused townhouses with cafes and galleries.
facts.excerpt: 町家を改装したカフェ、ギャラリー、居酒屋などの新店

facts.fact: Higashimachi continues fromHonmachi and retains historical streets with everyday residentiallife; access to streets does not imply open private houses.
facts.excerpt: 本町通りに続く東町の通りも歴史と生活感が絶妙に調和し
facts.location: 同じカテゴリのスポット / 東町
